row: The Herd That Heals: Tecate Horse Rescue

Welcome to The Herd That Heals — where rescued horses find new life, and in the process, help humans heal too. 🐴💜

Here you’ll meet incredible rescue stories, learn how horses teach us compassion, resilience, and trust, and see the daily life of running a 100-acre horse rescue and wellness ranch. From before-and-after transformations to inspiring lessons from the herd, each video is a reminder that healing is possible — for horses and humans alike.

Expect:
✨ Heartfelt rescue stories
✨ Equine-assisted therapy insights
✨ Behind-the-scenes ranch life
✨ Live music & storytelling with the herd
✨ Ways you can join our mission

Subscribe and be part of a community that believes in second chances. Together, we rescue, rehabilitate, and reconnect — because when horses heal, humans heal too.
